objective: Make RavenOS feel like one coherent market intelligence product before adding more isolated features.
principles: Prefer product coherence over feature count.
Keep technical provider details behind developer mode or tooltips.
Every module should answer what is happening, why, confidence, and what changed.

issues.problem: Different pages use different headers, navigation order, account controls, and workspace context patterns.
issues.recommended_fix: Create one shared product shell with global nav, workspace context, and account/access controls.
issues.expected_user_impact: Users can move through RavenOS as one system instead of relearning each page.

issues.problem: Terminal has a global lookup and a table search that look like competing search boxes.
issues.recommended_fix: Keep global search as the only instrument lookup and label the table search as a row filter.
issues.expected_user_impact: Users know exactly where to search tokens, pairs, contracts, and symbols.

issues.problem: The most valuable explanation, replay, and participant reads are often below controls, access prompts, or diagnostic panels.
issues.recommended_fix: Introduce a compact Raven Read block on each core page with current state, why, confidence, and what changed.
issues.expected_user_impact: First-time users understand product value within 60 seconds.

issues.problem: Coverage labels vary between live, public, sample, preview, limited coverage, developing coverage, delayed context, and unavailable.
issues.recommended_fix: Standardize product-facing coverage labels and keep raw provider state in developer mode.
issues.expected_user_impact: Users understand data quality without infrastructure noise.

issues.problem: Flow, pressure, survival, attention, replay, liquidity, risk, and confidence compete without a consistent hierarchy.
issues.recommended_fix: Define primary state score, driver metrics, and trust metrics per module.
issues.expected_user_impact: Users understand headline metrics and supporting context faster.

issues.problem: Chart overlays now have better defaults but need one shared legend and visual identity contract across modules.
issues.recommended_fix: Make Perps, Degen, and Atlas overlay families first-class with consistent glyphs, colors, hover details, and default visibility.
issues.expected_user_impact: Users identify market state visually instead of reading chart labels.

issues.problem: Structure Lab still leans toward tables and raw rows even after report-language improvements.
issues.recommended_fix: Make findings cards the default and move raw tables behind details or developer mode.
issues.expected_user_impact: Research feels like findings rather than a data export.

issues.problem: Perps has the right modules but needs a clearer sequence from pressure to source to replay to conditions to research status.
issues.recommended_fix: Reframe Perps around current pressure state, source, replay, improving/weakening conditions, and paper research status.
issues.expected_user_impact: Perps becomes a flagship RavenOS experience instead of another analytics dashboard.

issues.problem: Wallet, upgrade, Pro, Founder, Atlas, subscription, and token-holder access copy appears in many panels.
issues.recommended_fix: Centralize access language in Account/Access controls and use compact locked previews in modules.
issues.expected_user_impact: Users focus on product value before paywall mechanics.

issues.problem: Degen Terminal exists locally but is not fully registered, committed, tested, or using the shared product shell.
issues.recommended_fix: Finish Degen as a Pro crypto-discovery module or keep it hidden until integrated.
issues.expected_user_impact: Avoids exposing an isolated experience that weakens product coherence.

issues.problem: Tables are dense but do not adapt cleanly by context or screen size.
issues.recommended_fix: Create compact, standard, and full table column presets.
issues.expected_user_impact: Mobile and mid-size layouts become usable without removing information.

issues.problem: Confidence exists but is not always shown next to the score or read it qualifies.
issues.recommended_fix: Show Low, Developing, Moderate, or High confidence beside every primary read.
issues.expected_user_impact: Users know whether a read is strong or still developing.

issues.problem: RavenOS does not consistently explain what changed since the previous update or last visit.
issues.recommended_fix: Add a reusable Changed field to the Raven Read model.
issues.expected_user_impact: RavenOS feels current and useful between sessions.

issues.problem: Atlas is positioned as a separate high-tier product but still feels visually similar to standard app pages.
issues.recommended_fix: Use a regime memo layout focused on market regime, liquidity, breadth, volatility, and cross-market posture.
issues.expected_user_impact: Atlas feels like a premium context layer.

issues.problem: Terms like candidate lanes, setup families, and paper tracking can feel internal to customers.
issues.recommended_fix: Translate internal terms to structure families, developing structures, and forward research tracking.
issues.expected_user_impact: Product language feels more polished without losing rigor.

issues.problem: Legal and safety copy appears with slight variations across pages.
issues.recommended_fix: Use one shared legal footer string.
issues.expected_user_impact: Reduces repetitive copy and improves professional consistency.

issues.problem: Pricing lists many features but does not clearly show the RavenOS workflow they unlock.
issues.recommended_fix: Frame pricing around explore, understand, monitor, research, and review context.
issues.expected_user_impact: Paid plans feel easier to understand and justify.

issues.problem: Developer diagnostics exist but lack a consistent authenticated/internal affordance.
issues.recommended_fix: Add internal-only diagnostics entry point while keeping normal users on product language.
issues.expected_user_impact: Power users retain detail without confusing paying customers.

recommended_sequence: Unify product shell across app pages.
Define and implement one Raven Read model.
Clarify Terminal global search versus table filtering.
Finish or hide Degen until fully integrated.
Align Pricing and Upgrade around the product workflow.
non_goals: No implementation of cleanup findings in this audit pass.
